name: Y2K 千禧风
description: 圆润亮面形体融合半透明软胶与银铬反光，色彩清亮，充满千禧科技趣味。
rendering_prompt: Shape the subject with the optimistic technological aesthetics of the early millennium. Use full, rounded forms and refined details reminiscent of early digital toys. Harmonize glossy plastic, translucent soft-gel materials, and small touches of liquid-chrome reflection. Clear silver-white, ice blue, candy pink, and related bright colors should create lively contrast. Keep edges smooth, highlights crisp, and materials distinct for a light, fashionable result without relying on added decoration.
avoid: 全表面金属、暗黑霓虹、自动贴品牌标志
difference: Y2K 混合多种明亮科技材质；液态金属以连续银铬为主
tuning: 让塑料、软胶、铬各有可辨的反光方式，保持轮廓光滑。
